serve-plus-one.bridge: Use the serve to set up the next ball, then read the return you actually get.

short-ball.bridge: Read the ball and create space before deciding how to attack.

the-line.bridge: Test whether the line is available while the point keeps moving.

recovery.bridge: Choose a reply, then decide when to recover.

open-court.bridge: Check the opening and your own position before changing direction.

approach-volley.bridge: Choose the first volley and prepare for the next reply.

middle-return.bridge: Choose a return that gives you a workable next ball.

net-rusher.bridge: Use the first pass to shape the next opening.

pass-where-they-arent.bridge: Read the net player, then make the next passing decision.

pulled-wide.bridge: Buy time with the reply and use it to recover.

find-your-return-spot.bridge: Read the serve and make the return decision under pressure.

answer-the-drop.bridge: Read how you arrive before choosing your reply.

down-the-line.bridge: Make the direction decision in a changing point.

rushed-out-wide.bridge: Read the reply and recovery as two connected decisions.

earned-attack.bridge: See how your preparation changes the attacking options.

earned-defence.bridge: Choose enough time to get back into the point.

earned-net.bridge: Build from the first volley instead of rushing the finish.

predict-the-point.bridge: Anticipate the return, then respond to the ball you actually receive.

predict-second-serve.bridge: Take the return read into a point with consequences.

serve-plus-one.title: Your wide serve worked. Now what?
serve-plus-one.setup: Watch two returns. Choose your next move.

short-ball.title: A short ball. An easy winner?
short-ball.setup: Their slice stays low. Decide how much to attack.

the-line.title: The line is open. Are you ready?
the-line.setup: You are wide and late. Make your call.

the-winner.title: A winner. But the right choice?
the-winner.setup: You clip the line. Decide what that really tells you.

recovery.title: Your shot is good. Where next?
recovery.setup: You have pulled them wide. Find your recovery spot.

open-court.title: Open court. Or behind them?
open-court.setup: Watch the defender move before choosing your target.

forehand-bill.title: Run around—or hold your ground?
forehand-bill.setup: A deep ball to your backhand. Weigh the forehand against the recovery.

the-lead.title: 5–2 up. Why change now?
the-lead.setup: Your rally ball is getting shorter. Choose your next intention.

split-step.title: Ready to move. A moment too late?
split-step.setup: Watch the split step and the first move.

approach-volley.title: Which approach earns the volley?
approach-volley.setup: A short forehand. Choose how to come forward.

middle-return.title: Big serve. Where do you return?
middle-return.setup: You are pulled wide. The server is waiting for your reply.

high-ball.title: Same high ball. Same answer?
high-ball.setup: Read your time and contact before choosing where to meet it.

second-serve.title: Both serves land in. Equally safe?
second-serve.setup: Watch where the returner meets each second serve.

contact-clue.title: Into the net. What would you change?
contact-clue.setup: Look closely at the moment the ball meets your racket.

running-around.title: Time for your forehand?
running-around.setup: Your slice has bought time. Decide how to use it.

net-rusher.title: At their feet—or over their head?
net-rusher.setup: They come to net. Read where they stop.

pass-where-they-arent.title: They close the net. Where is the gap?
pass-where-they-arent.setup: Watch which side they cover before choosing your pass.

late-is-the-culprit.title: Wide again. What is the clue?
late-is-the-culprit.setup: You aimed crosscourt. Freeze the contact and take a closer look.

the-moonballer.title: Another high ball. Your move?
the-moonballer.setup: It will bounce above your shoulder. Choose where to take it.

the-pusher.title: They get everything back. Now what?
the-pusher.setup: A shorter ball gives you a chance to change the pattern.

pulled-wide.title: Off the court. Still in the point.
pulled-wide.setup: You reach it low and late. Choose your reply.

serve-away-from-the-lean.title: They are leaning. Where do you serve?
serve-away-from-the-lean.setup: Read the returner before choosing your first-serve target.

the-big-hitter.title: Their pace. Your starting position.
the-big-hitter.setup: A big forehand is coming. Decide where to wait.

the-lefty.title: A lefty. Does your pattern still work?
the-lefty.setup: You have run around your backhand. Choose your forehand target.

find-your-return-spot.title: Big serve. Where do you stand?
find-your-return-spot.setup: Watch the serve, then choose your starting position.

answer-the-drop.title: You reach the drop. What next?
answer-the-drop.setup: You arrive in time. Read where your opponent has stopped.

attack-the-backhand.title: They know you want their backhand.
attack-the-backhand.setup: They are leaning to protect it. Choose where to go first.

down-the-line.title: Is this your ball down the line?
down-the-line.setup: You step into a shorter ball. Read their recovery.

rushed-out-wide.title: Just reached it. What do you play?
rushed-out-wide.setup: You are stretched wide. Compare your options.

earned-attack.title: Open space. Have you earned it?
earned-attack.setup: Read your arrival before deciding to attack.

earned-defence.title: Pulled wide. Is defence the only choice?
earned-defence.setup: Watch your arrival and your opponent before choosing.

earned-net.title: A short reply. Should you follow?
earned-net.setup: Read your contact before committing to the net.
